label: RADWIN 5000 JET
description: RADWIN 5000 JET - sub-6 GHz PtMP beamforming base station (HBS), up to 750 Mbps per sector (QAM256) and 3 Gbps per cell over four sectors, range up to 40 km; multiband 4.9-5.8 GHz or 3.3-3.8/3.65 GHz in the same unit; two 10/100/1000BaseT RJ45 ports (data with PoE-in, plus management), HBS draws under 25 W.
notes: RADWIN product brochure, August 2016 edition, read 2026-11-28. Interfaces row: **HBS: Two ports for Data & management, 10/100/1000BaseT** (HSU: 10/100BaseT); Power row: **Power Feeding Provided over PoE interface; Power Consumption HBS < 25W, HSU < 12 W**; Radio row: multiband 4.9-5.8 GHz or 3.3-3.8/3.65 GHz, up to 40 km, max net aggregate capacity 750 Mbps at QAM256 on the 4.9-5.8 GHz HBS (250 Mbps in 3.3-3.8 GHz), cell capacity 3 Gbps over 4 sectors using 2 x 80 MHz channels. There is no SFP cage on this platform: the earlier (2015) edition of the same brochure at https://www.4gon.co.uk/documents/radwin_5000_jet_datasheet.pdf prints the same Interfaces row, and the only SFP is on the later JET PRO / JET DUO / JET AIR units, whose series table at https://www.radwin.com/web/content/3699 reads `Data interfaces 100/1000 Mbps RJ45 PoE, 1Gbps Full duplex SFP` - a different product generation, not this one. Which port takes the power is stated by the 5000 JET NLOS data sheet (https://www.skylinkstelecoms.ie/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/RADWIN-5000-JET-NLOS-EN.pdf): `Two ports, supporting 100/1000BaseT. 1st port: Data and PoE. 2nd port: Data (HSU), Management (HBS)`, so eth1 is declared unable to sink power rather than left to the engine's PD guess. RADWIN's RADWIN 5000 installation guide (https://tools.radwin.com/documentation/installation/, August 2023, section on input voltage) lists `RADWIN 5000 JET | 55VDC, 0.5A | IP67/Type 4 | -35C to +60C`, i.e. 27.5 W maximum input against the brochure's < 25 W consumption figure; the 25 W here is the vendor's stated HBS consumption. This row models the HBS (sector base station) only - the subscriber units (HSU 510/525/550) are separate hardware with a single 10/100BaseT port and are not covered by this spec.
